description: Manage informational HTTPS webhook subscriptions for deterministic EveryAILaw corpus changes. Registration returns a signing secret once and requires endpoint challenge verification.

action.description: One of: list, register, verify, rotate_secret, remove.

endpoint_id.description: Webhook endpoint ID for verify, rotate_secret, or remove.

filters.description: Optional exact filters: jurisdictions, roles, obligations, and change_types.

profile_id.description: Saved Pro profile ID for registration.

url.description: Public HTTPS webhook URL on port 443 for registration.

name: subscribe_to_changes
